implementation_strategy: Use the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter to call the hosted model gpt-5-mini via the provider openai_responses. For each of the 300 deterministic, stratified tasks (seed=2026-08-25) perform a single shared initial generation call (shared_initial_candidate) and, if the deterministic verifier counterexample appears for the guarded condition, perform at most one repair-generation call. All verifier checks and sandbox simulations run deterministically on CPU/docker; scoring is fully automated and deterministic. No human labour or external private resources are used.
public_resources: SyntheticNetOps-Seeded-2026 (public task templates and seed list; preregistration artifact hashes stored)
Verifier and sandbox source (Batfish-style deterministic simulator and verifier scripts; public repository linked in execution manifest)
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic stratified sampler (routing:150, ACL:100, BGP:50) with seed=2026-08-25; templates are public and hashed; tasks requiring proprietary vendor features are deterministically excluded.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (LLM -> canonical config). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (LLM generation -> deterministic verifier -> at most one LLM repair prompt conditioned on verifier counterexample). All parsing/canonicalization automated.
randomisation_plan: Deterministic stratified sampling with seed=2026-08-25. Within each stratum tasks are enumerated deterministically; no random shuffling that would break reproducibility.
caching_plan: Cache all raw LLM responses, parsed canonical configs, verifier outputs, repair prompts, and sandbox traces. Cached outputs reused to avoid duplicate model calls; cache keys are deterministic hashes of (task-template, prompt, seed, adapter parameters).
failure_recovery_plan: Per-call maximum_attempts_per_call=1. On transient provider/API error, pause and retry the affected batch as a new call subject to the global maximum_model_calls budget; if repeated provider/API failures prevent completion within wall-clock limit or budget, halt and report as per stopping_rule. All failures logged deterministically. No human adjudication.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-task episodes for baseline and guarded; fields: task_id, condition, raw_llm_output_hash, parsed_canonical_config_hash, verifier_result {pass/fail, counterexample}, sandbox_outcome {safe/unsafe}, automated_score {unsafe_accepted:boolean}, timestamps, hashes).
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated_model_calls = task_count + expected_repair_calls. Assuming ~50% of tasks trigger one repair under guarded condition: 300 initial shared generations + 150 repair calls = 450 estimated calls. Maximum_model_calls = task_count * 2 = 600 (worst-case: every task requires a repair). Token limits: max_output_tokens set to 2000; expected average output << max; execution uses hosted API (no local GPU). Wall-clock fits capability manifest (hosted APIs, 6 batches). All numeric totals logged and derivations preserved in execution manifest hashes.
